en.answer: If there is no longer a Fiend-Type monster in the hand to discard, the effect of <<9872>> will not apply. (The targeted card in the Graveyard is not banished.)
en.question: When resolving the effect of <<9872>>, if there is no longer a Fiend-Type monster in the hand to discard, is the targeted card in the Graveyard still banished?
en.title: When resolving the effect of <<9872>>, if there is no longer a Fiend-Type monster in the hand to discard, is the targeted card in the Graveyard still banished?

ja.answer:
「<<9872>>」の効果処理時、自分の手札に悪魔族モンスターが存在しなくなった場合には、効果処理は適用されません。
（『手札から悪魔族モンスター１体を捨て』の処理が行われませんので、対象のモンスターが除外される事もありません。）
